verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev automates actions through code. Tasks are triggered programmatically from your app (handle-based triggering), run on cron schedules that can be managed in the dashboard without redeploying, and failure events can fire alerts via email, Slack or webhooks. There is no evidence of a declarative event-to-action rule system. Missing for 10: a declarative rule or event-subscription mechanism (e.g. firing tasks on arbitrary external or webhook events without hand-written trigger code), documented event-filter conditions, and independent corroboration of event-driven automation beyond scheduled tasks.
